items.title: How Many Shares of Chevron, Shell or Exxon Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about $360,000 of Shell stock, $351,300 of Chevron or $448,600 of ExxonMobil. All three cover their dividends comfortably, paying out between 27% and 41% of free cash flow over their latest twelve months.

items.title: What Does Chevron (CVX) Greece Offshore Exploration Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) and HELLENiQ ENERGY plan to start offshore oil and gas exploration in the southern Ionian Sea in Greece. The initiative focuses on potential hydrocarbon resources in deepwater blocks that form part of Greece's push to increase domestic energy output. Greek authorities have framed the project as part of a broader effort to balance energy security goals with environmental safeguards in the region.
